-- ac/BB.java --
package ac;
@NiagaraProperty(name="a", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="b", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="c", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="d", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="e", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="f", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="g", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="value", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraAction(
  name = "push",
  flags = Flags.OPERATOR
)
@NiagaraAction(name = "poke", flags = Flags.OPERATOR) @NiagaraAction(name = "jab")
@NiagaraAction
@NiagaraAction(flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraAction(name="tick", parameterType="BDouble", defaultValue="BDouble.make(f(1))")
public class BB extends BComponent
{
  public void doPush()
  {
    setA(BDouble.make(1));
    getB().setValue(2);
    set(c, x, null);
    this.set(d, x);
  }
  public void doPoke() { resetE(); }
  public void doJab(BValue v) { getF().setValue(3); }
  public void doTick(BDouble v)
  {
    if (v != null) {
      setG(v);
    }
  }
  public void execute() { setH(1); }
  public void doUnknown() { setG(1); }
}
-- ac/BC.java --
package ac;
@NiagaraProperty(name="x", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraProperty(name="y", type="BStatusNumeric", flags=Flags.OPERATOR)
@NiagaraAction(name="kick")
public class BC extends BComponent
{
  @Override
  public void doKick()
  {
    setX(1);
  }
  public BStatusNumeric getY() { return y; }
  public void setY(BStatusNumeric v) { set(y, v, null); }
  class Inner {
    void doKick() { setY(1); }
  }
}
